see.title: What BRAM can see
see.description: Only what you choose here is shared with BRAM. It cannot control any of it.

rooms.title: Fix a person's room
rooms.description: You usually do not need this: BRAM finds these by itself. Change one only if a person shows the wrong room. Each is the sensor that says which room they are in.

chat.title: What BRAM may look into
chat.description: Lets the BRAM Server read more than the live state, to answer you and to fill its own history. BRAM finds problems by itself without these; see What BRAM watches for. History covers only devices BRAM can see. Problems sends short summaries of errors, repairs, low batteries, and updates, with passwords, tokens, and addresses removed. Removal cannot catch everything. The security check sends findings and device names, never account names.

data.share_history: History of the devices BRAM can see, 10 days

learn.title: Learning
learn.description:
BRAM watches when your home goes quiet at night and how long doors stay open, then suggests better night hours and left-open times. Suggestions appear in Settings > System > Repairs. Nothing changes until you approve one.

Nights noted so far: {nights} of the 14 needed. The first is noted at noon after its night.

data.undo: Undo the last change I approved
data.forget: Erase what BRAM has learned and start over

data_description.learn: Turning this off stops noting new nights. What was noted is kept.
data_description.undo: Puts back the hours you had before you approved the last suggestion.
data_description.forget: Your current hours stay as they are. BRAM forgets the nights it noted, any waiting suggestion, and your Never answers.

watch.title: What BRAM watches for
watch.description: Problems covers all of Home Assistant, and sends what it finds to the BRAM Server, with passwords, tokens, and addresses removed; removal cannot catch everything. Lock and door rules cover what BRAM can see. Night and away messages ignore quiet hours. Away counts only the people BRAM can see, so add everyone who lives here first.
